limits: Mask filters reference points; no tool clipping or full-tool containment claim.
Original CUT stays unconditional. Hole boundary excludes additional references.
Actual source edit changes the main outer edge of a hole-bearing sketch; it does not claim direct UI editing of stored hole coordinates.
Out-of-budget source is excluded by the actual region picker before copying; numeric preview refusal is tested separately.
One Chrome with serial contexts; hooks only observe.
Hashes prove source provenance, not geometry correctness.
